name: I-COVID 19
tagline: Yintoni omawuyenze namhlanje. I-COVID ende. Isitofu.

what_is_it.heading: I-COVID-19 ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-COVID-19 ibangelwa yintsholongwane ye-SARS-CoV-2. Ngo-2026 sele iyinto eqhelekileyo - ijikeleza unyaka wonke, kunye namaza onyaka. Uninzi lweemeko ngoku zithambile, kodwa intsholongwane isabulala abantu abasesichengeni.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhe bane-COVID-19 okanye baye bagonywa. Ukunganyangeki okudityanisiweyo kwenze ukuba isifo sibe buthathaka kuninzi. Ukwahluka okutsha kusavela, kwaye abantu abadala, abangakhuselekanga, kunye nabangagonywanga bahlala besengozini enkulu yokugula kakhulu.

I-COVID ende-impawu ezihlala iinyanga emva kosulelo-ichaphazela inani elinentsingiselo labantu abachachayo kusulelo oluqatha. Ukudinwa, ukuphefumla, inkungu yobuchopho, neentlungu zesifuba zixhaphakile. Ukunciphisa inani lamaxesha owasulelwa ngalo kunciphisa umngcipheko wakho omude we-COVID.

items.headline: Sisifo esihlala sikhona
items.body: I-COVID ngoku iyinxalenye esisigxina yobomi. Amaza onyaka ayaqhubeka. Ii-boosters zinceda ukunciphisa ubungqongqo, hayi ukuyeka usulelo ngokupheleleyo.

items.headline: I-COVID ende
items.body: Phantse i-10-20% yosulelo lukhokelela kwiimpawu ezihlala iinyanga. Ukosuleleka kwakhona ngalunye kongeza umngcipheko - usulelo olumbalwa lungcono.

items.headline: Izitofu zokugonya zasimahla
items.body: Zonke izitofu zokugonyela i-COVID kunye nezincedisi ezihlaziyiweyo zihlala zisimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente. Icetyiswa minyaka le kumaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu.

items.headline: Ikakhulu ukhathalelo lwasekhaya
items.body: Iimeko ezininzi zifuna ukuphumla, ulwelo kunye nexesha. Ii-antivirals zikhona kumaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu - bona ikliniki phakathi kweentsuku ezi-5 zeempawu.

pull_quote.text: Isigaba sobhubhane siphelile. I-COVID-19 ayikho. Yiphathe njengomkhuhlane-gonya, khupha umoya, hlala ekhaya xa ugula, kwaye ukhusele abo basesichengeni abakungqongileyo.

signs.heading: Ijongeka njani i-COVID ngoku
signs.lede: Uninzi lweemeko ze-COVID zangoku zikhangeleka ngathi ngumkhuhlane obandayo okanye opholileyo. Ilahleko yakudala yencasa kunye nevumba elivela kumaza angaphambili ngoku ayiqhelekanga.

items.title: Iimpawu eziqhelekileyo
items.description: Umqala obuhlungu, impumlo ebuhlungu, ukhohlokhohlo, intloko ebuhlungu, ukudinwa, umkhuhlane ongephi, umzimba obuhlungu. Idla ngokuphazamana nomkhuhlane okanye umkhuhlane.

items.title: Ayiqhelekanga ngoku
items.description: Ukulahleka kwencasa okanye iphunga, ukuphefumula okunzima, intlungu yesifuba. Kusenokwenzeka - ngakumbi kubantu abangagonywanga.

items.title: Fumana uncedo lwezonyango ukuba
items.description: Ubunzima bokuphefumla, iintlungu zesifuba, ukudideka, imilebe eluhlaza, ukuhlanza okuzingileyo, okanye iimpawu eziba mandundu emva kokuphuculwa kokuqala.

spreads.heading: Isasazeka njani i-COVID
yes: Ukuphefumla amathontsi amancinci kunye ne-aerosols evela kubantu abosulelekileyo
Vala uqhagamshelo olude kwiindawo zangaphakathi ezingangeni moya kakuhle
Ukuchukumisa umphezulu ongcolisekileyo, emva koko ubambe ubuso (ixhaphake kakhulu kunomoya)
no: Uqhagamshelwano oluqhelekileyo lwangaphandle (lunqabile ngaphandle kokuba lusondele kakhulu kwaye lude)
Izilwanyana zasekhaya kunye nezilwanyana (zinqabile kwaye azibalulekanga ekusasazeni kwabantu)

items.myth: I-COVID iphelile. Akusekho mfuneko yokuba sicinge ngayo kwakhona.
items.fact: I-COVID igqugqisile, ayihambanga. Isababulala abantu abasesichengeni kwaye ibangela iingxaki zexesha elide. Ingqiqo yesiqhelo ibalulekile - hayi ukuphakuzela.
Ukungakhuseleki kusulelo oludlulileyo kuyaphela kwiinyanga kwaye kuyahluka ngokohluka. Ukosuleleka kwakhona kuqhelekile. Ugonyo kunye nosulelo oludlulileyo lunika ukhuseleko oluluqilima.

items.myth: Isitofu sokugonya siyingozi ngakumbi kunesi sifo.
items.fact: Iminyaka yedatha yehlabathi ibonisa izitofu zokugonya zinciphisa ukugula kakhulu, ukulaliswa esibhedlele kunye nokufa. Iziphumo ezibi kakhulu zesitofu sokugonya zinqabile kwaye zinqabile kakhulu kuneengxaki ezimandundu ze-COVID.
I-COVID ende ibhalwe kakuhle ngokwasemzimbeni - ii-biomarkers, ukonakala kwamalungu, utshintsho lomzimba. Akukho ntloko yomguli. Unyango luyaphucuka.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela wena kunye nabanye
prevention.lede: Uninzi lothintelo luyinto yesiqhelo ngoku - njengomkhuhlane. Amaqela asemngciphekweni omkhulu asazuza kakhulu kumanyathelo okhuseleko asebenzayo.

items.title: Hlala usexesheni kwii-boosters
items.description: Ii-boosters ze-COVID zonyaka ziyacetyiswa kubantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-50, abagonywanga, ukugula okungapheliyo, kunye nabasebenzi bezempilo. Zisimahla kwiikliniki.

items.title: Ukungenisa umoya
items.description: Vula iifestile. Zikhuphele ngaphandle iindibano zokuzonwabisa xa kunokwenzeka. Umgangatho womoya wangaphakathi yeyona nto inkulu ekusasazeni kwe-COVID.

items.title: Imaski kwiindawo ezinomngcipheko ophezulu
items.description: Izibhedlele, iiklinikhi, izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezixinene ngaphakathi ngexesha lamaza. Ingakumbi ukuba uhlala nomntu osengozini.

items.title: Hlala ekhaya xa ugula
items.description: Nokuba yi-COVID, umkhuhlane, okanye nantoni na eyenye- ukuhlala ekhaya kukhusela abantu abakungqongileyo. Vavanya ukuba unofikelelo.

items.title: Vavanya ukuba unofikelelo
items.description: Iimvavanyo ze-antigen ezikhawulezayo ziyafumaneka kwiikhemesti ezininzi. Ukwazi kukunceda ukukhusela abanye kwaye uthathe isigqibo sokuba usengozini enkulu na kwii-antivirals.

items.title: Ukuphumla, ulwelo, iparacetamol
items.description: Kuyafana nomkhuhlane. Lala, hydrate, lawula umkhuhlane kunye neentlungu ngeparacetamol okanye ibuprofen.

items.title: Yiba yedwa ngelixa usulelo
items.description: Hlala ekhaya ubuncinane iintsuku ezi-5 ukusuka ekuqaleni kweempawu. Imaski ejikeleze amalungu osapho. Kuphephe ukutyelela abantu abadala okanye izalamane ezibuthathaka.

items.title: Ukuba usengozini enkulu - bonana ekliniki kwangoko
items.description: Ngaphezu kwama-60, ukhulelwe, ukugula okungapheliyo, i-immunocompromised? Iyeza le-Antiviral (Paxlovid) lisebenza kakuhle kwiintsuku ze-5 zeempawu. Buza kwangethuba.

items.title: Bukela ixesha elide le-COVID
items.description: Iimpawu ezingaphaya kweeveki ze-4 - ukudinwa, inkungu yengqondo, ukuphefumla, intlungu yesifuba - zifanelwe ukuhlolwa ngugqirha. Zikhona iindlela zonyango.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo lwe-COVID ludityaniswe kwiinkonzo zeklinikhi eziqhelekileyo. Akukho minxeba ikhethekileyo ifunekayo - ikliniki yakho yesiqhelo okanye ikhemesti ingakunceda.
